{
  "id": "mprawwui44",
  "title": "Webapp: Unify loading states and redesign empty states",
  "description": "## Context
Loading states and empty states create the user's first impression of reliability. Currently they use inconsistent skeleton patterns and the empty state lacks visual hierarchy or guidance.

## Scope

### 1. Skeleton Loading Consistency
- Audit all skeleton usages: `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx`
- Standardize skeleton patterns:
  - **Issue list skeleton**: Match the shape of IssueRow (status dot, title line, meta line)
  - **Issue detail skeleton**: Match the layout of IssueDetailPage sections
  - **Comments skeleton**: Match comment card structure
- Ensure consistent skeleton sizing (height, width, border-radius)
- Use the design token spacing/border-radius variables

### 2. Empty State Redesign (IssuesPage.tsx, IssueList.tsx)
- Replace the current "No issues yet" message with a designed empty state:
  - Large icon or illustration
  - Clear heading ("No issues yet")
  - Descriptive subtext ("Create your first issue to get started")
  - Prominent call-to-action button ("Create Issue") that opens CreateIssueDialog
- Consider different empty states for:
  - No issues at all (new project)
  - No issues matching current filters (suggest clearing filters)
- Add subtle animation (fade-in) for the empty state

### 3. Loading Feedback for Mutations
- Add loading state to CreateIssueDialog submit button
- Add loading state to any form submissions in issue detail
- Disable form inputs during submission
- Show success/error toast or inline feedback after mutation completes

## Files to Modify
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx` (ensure it uses design tokens)
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueList.tsx` (empty state)
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueRow.tsx` (skeleton matching)
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/pages/IssuesPage.tsx` (empty state)
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/CreateIssueDialog.tsx` (loading states)
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issue-detail/CommentsSection.tsx` (skeleton)
- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/pages/IssueDetailPage.tsx` (skeleton)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All skeleton loaders match the shape and size of the content they replace
- [ ] Empty state is visually engaging with clear CTA
- [ ] Filtered empty state suggests clearing filters
- [ ] Form submissions show loading state on buttons
- [ ] No layout shift when transitioning from skeleton → loaded content
- [ ] Empty state works responsively on mobile

## Constraints
- Use design tokens from the CSS variable system
- Don't introduce new dependencies — use existing shadcn/ui components
- Keep skeleton component compatible with shadcn/ui patterns",
